jobs.description:
Our client is an innovative manufacturing company seeking an experienced engineering professional to strengthen its operations and accelerate continuous improvement projects.

Jobomschrijving

• Lead and execute manufacturing improvement and process optimization projects while managing multiple priorities.
• Identify production bottlenecks, implement practical solutions, and deliver measurable operational improvements.
• Drive automation initiatives by evaluating, improving, and supporting industrial control systems and automation solutions.
• Provide technical expertise to production, quality, maintenance, and commercial teams, including support for quality issues and new product feasibility assessments.
• Ensure projects are delivered on time, aligned with business objectives, and contribute to long-term operational excellence.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical, Electromechanical, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related field.
• Proven experience in a manufacturing or production environment with expertise in project management, process optimization, automation, and continuous improvement.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, combined with a hands-on mindset and the ability to prioritize and deliver quick results.
• Good knowledge of SolidWorks and experience working with industrial machinery and manufacturing processes.
• Fluent in English with excellent communication skills; additional languages are considered an asset.

An organisation operating in the industrial/manufacturing industry based in Wijnegem. Accessible by car and public transportation.

Jobomschrijving

As a Supply Chain Officer your responsibilities are:

• Coordinate procurement activities to ensure timely delivery of goods and services.
• Monitor inventory levels and manage stock replenishment processes effectively.
• Ensure compliance with procurement policies and procedures.
• Collaborate with internal departments to forecast demand and plan supply accordingly.
• Organizing transportation of raw materials and finished goods.
• Analyse and optimise supply chain processes to improve efficiency.
• Handle documentation and administrative tasks related to procurement and supply chain management.

A successful Supply Chain Officer should have:

• A strong understanding of procurement and supply chain processes.
• Experience in the industrial/manufacturing sector is beneficial.
• Excellent organisational and problem-solving skills.
• Strong communication and negotiation abilities.
• Professional proficiency in English and French. 
• Attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple tasks effectively.

Working at Michael Page means joining an entrepreneurial, fast-paced, and performance-driven environment where consultants are empowered to develop their own client portfolio, advise businesses on talent strategies, and make a real impact on people's careers. The company promotes a culture of teamwork, integrity, meritocracy, and continuous career development.

Jobomschrijving

As a Recruitment Consultant your responsibilities are:

• Develop and maintain strong relationships with clients and candidates.
• Identify and source top talent through various recruitment methods.
• Manage the full recruitment cycle, from job briefing to offer negotiation.
• Provide expert advice to clients on market trends and hiring strategies.
• Screen, interview, and assess candidates for suitability.
• Ensure a high standard of service delivery to both clients and candidates.

A successful Recruitment Consultant should have:

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
• An ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities effectively.
• Fluency in English and French OR Dutch.
• Passion for sales, recruitment, and business development
• A proactive mindset.

Our client is a major real estate and infrastructure organization managing large-scale public-private partnership projects focused on the development, operation, and long-term maintenance of public facilities.

Jobomschrijving

• Manage a portfolio of approximately 25 building projects, coordinating maintenance activities and ensuring smooth collaboration between clients, contractors, and other stakeholders.
• Act as the main point of contact for administrative, technical, contractual, insurance, and damage-related matters, while mediating conflicts and facilitating mutually acceptable solutions.
• Coordinate maintenance requests, technical inspections, change requests, and interventions through a dedicated helpdesk and ensure proper follow-up with the relevant parties.
• Monitor the technical condition, regulatory compliance, and overall performance of the buildings, including annual condition assessments based on NEN 2767 standards and follow-up of corrective actions.
• Prepare and maintain accurate documentation, meeting reports, and records in the document management system, while supporting stakeholders in improving the energy efficiency of the buildings.

• Bachelor's degree in Construction Engineering, Facility Management, Real Estate, or equivalent professional experience, with 3-5 years of relevant experience in maintenance, technical consultancy, or real estate.
• Strong knowledge of building technical systems and maintenance requirements, ideally gained through experience with schools, offices, hospitals, or other large public/commercial buildings.
• Excellent communication, consultation, negotiation, and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to mediate conflicts and build strong professional relationships.
• Proactive, customer-oriented, highly organized, and solution-driven, with strong attention to detail and the ability to work independently as well as within multidisciplinary teams.
• Fluent in Dutch, with a good command of French and English, and proficient in MS Office and technical/construction documentation tools such as CAD and relevant maintenance or project-management applications.

jobs.occupation: Customer Service Officer: English + Czech + Polish OR Lituanian - Multiple shifts - Oostakker
jobs.description:
For our client we're looking for a Customer Service Officer.
In this role, you become the voice of support for drivers facing unexpected vehicle issues across Europe. You'll be part of a fast-paced and multilingual contact center where your communication skills, empathy, and sense of urgency play a crucial role in keeping transport moving.
 

 
• Handle incoming assistance requests from international customers experiencing roadside vehicle breakdowns. 
 
• Take ownership of each case by coordinating with local service providers and technicians until the issue is resolved. 
 
• Maintain constant communication with both the customer and service partner, providing regular updates and reassurance. 
 
• Think on your feet and apply a proactive approach to problem-solving, often finding creative solutions under time pressure. 
 
• Be an integral part of a tight-knit, multilingual team that thrives on collaboration and mutual support. 
 
• Operate within a 24/7 environment, where teamwork and flexibility are essential to ensuring seamless customer experiences. 

- You speak and write fluently in English + Czech, and Lithuanian and/or Polish 

 
• You are service-driven and naturally inclined to go the extra mile to support customers in stressful situations. 
 
• Strong interpersonal skills help you adapt your communication style to various cultural and professional contexts. 
 
• You enjoy working in a diverse team setting and are always ready to help others succeed. 
 
• Flexibility to work in a rotating shift schedule, including nights and weekends. 
 
• A hands-on mentality with a structured and solution-oriented mindset. 
 
• Eagerness to continuously develop your skills and embrace new challenges.

About this job
Are you comfortable taking the lead in a production environment? Do you enjoy combining people management with a strong focus on quality and efficiency? For a growing company, we are looking for a Packaging Team Leader to strengthen the operations team.
Jouw verantwoordelijkheden
In this role, you ensure that the packaging department operates smoothly from start to finish.

• Prepare and organize the daily packaging activities.
• Guide employees and distribute tasks across the team.
• Keep a close eye on product quality, hygiene and safety procedures.
• Follow up on packaging orders and coordinate priorities.
• Act quickly when technical or operational issues occur.
• Look for practical ways to improve efficiency on the production floor.
• Maintain clear communication with production planning and finished goods storage.
• Keep the Production Manager informed about progress and possible challenges.
• Help introduce and optimize the use of MES and ERP systems within the department.

• A first experience in production is preferred; experience in the food industry is a strong advantage.
• You are confident when guiding colleagues and making decisions on the work floor.
• A practical mindset and a flexible attitude come naturally to you.
• You work accurately and have an eye for quality and detail.
• Good English communication skills are required.
• You are comfortable using computer systems and willing to learn new software.
• Working in two shifts fits your availability.

About this job
For a foodcompany in Meulebeke, we are looking for a line supervisor for a 2-shift schedule.
Jouw verantwoordelijkheden
You will start up the production process, operate the machines, and oversee smooth operations. In case of malfunctions, you will troubleshoot them or call in a technician. You follow the production planning and ensure efficient communication with colleagues. Additionally, you actively participate on the production floor.

What are we looking for?

• You are able to work very independently
• You have a strong sense of responsibility and know how to take action
• You have some technical insight
• You have a good knowledge of English or Dutch
• You are willing to work in 2 shifts
• It is a plus if you can operate a forklift

Step into the world of biotechnology and be part of a dynamic team! Legend Biotech, a leading biotechnology company, is looking for 
Cleaning Operators for their laboratory. You will be thoroughly
 trained in aseptic (germ-free) and GMP work and related procedures before joining our professional team. As a 
Cleaning Operator, you will be responsible for 
keeping the assigned areas and production zones within the laboratory spotlessly clean. You will ensure the maintenance of the equipment used and clean and disinfect materials with the highest accuracy. You handle cleaning products and materials in 
a safe and correct manner. The laboratory works with biological products in a strictly temperature-controlled environment, where 
human lives depend on your diligence.

 
• Order and cleanliness are of great importance to you.
 
• Possible experience in an environment that needs to be kept clean is a plus
 
• An enthusiastic team player, you can work both accurately and independently.
 
• You have a good command of the Dutch or English language.
 
• Wearing a sterile suit and strict adherence to procedures are no problem for you.

We are looking for an enthusiastic sorting assistant for a company in Zulte that specializes in sorting and distributing clothing!

We are looking for a motivated sorting assistant to join our team.

In this position, you will be responsible for sorting various materials and processing them correctly.

What will you be doing?

• Sorting second-hand clothing into different qualities.
• Working at a good pace – you are dynamic and accurate.
• No allergies to dust and no physical complaints.
• You preferably live nearby or you have a car

What are our expectations?

• Knowledge of Dutch or English is required.
• Willingness to perform physical work.
• You are not allergic to dust!
• You are not colourblind!
• Accuracy and attention to detail.
• You are looking for a long-term job.
• You live close to Zulte or you have a car
• You are motivated and enjoy working in a team.

Our client is looking for a commercially driven professional who thrives in an international B2B environment. This position combines business development, account management, and strategic sales activities, offering significant autonomy and long-term career opportunities.

 

Bedrijfsomschrijving

Our client is an internationally active company within the food industry, recognised for its commitment to quality, customer service, and long-term partnerships. Operating across multiple European markets, the organisation has built a strong reputation through its customer-centric approach and entrepreneurial mindset.

 

 

Omschrijving

• Develop and execute strategic sales plans across international markets
• Identify and acquire new business opportunities
• Build and maintain strong relationships with customers and partners
• Manage and further develop existing key accounts
• Conduct commercial negotiations and close business agreements
• Analyse market trends and identify growth opportunities
• Advise customers on products and tailored solutions
• Monitor sales performance and achieve revenue targets
• Represent the company at international trade fairs and networking events
• Collaborate closely with internal stakeholders to ensure excellent customer service
 

 

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent through experience
• Minimum 2 years of experience in sales, business development, or account management
• Fluent in English and at least one additional European language (Portuguese, Italian, Spanish, French, or similar)
• Proven experience managing the full sales cycle
• Strong communication and negotiation skills
• Results-oriented with a proactive and entrepreneurial mindset
• Excellent organisational and analytical abilities
• Customer-focused and relationship-driven
• Comfortable working in an international environment

The employer is a dynamic and growing organisation operating within a modern commercial and operational environment. Bringing together various services, activities and partners on one site, the company relies on strong internal coordination to ensure smooth day-to-day functioning. To support this mission, it is looking for an Office Manager who will play a key role in the operational and administrative management of the location.

Jobomschrijving

The Office Manager acts as a central point of coordination for the Technical Director and supports various operational teams across the shopping centre.

Administrative Management
 She/he manages internal and external communications, prepares and reviews documents, maintains updated tenant information, circulates weekly footfall data to the Landlord, the Property Manager and the internal team, and organises meetings and conferences. She/he also manages agendas, appointments and administrative workflows.

Coordination
 She/he collaborates closely with internal departments, external partners and tenants to ensure fluid communication and the smooth running of ongoing projects. Responsibilities include drafting meeting minutes, monitoring deadlines, managing office supplies, and overseeing the Info Desk schedule, orders and administrative tasks, including basic support with SUMUP-related matters.

Reception & Customer Relations
 As a representative of the shopping centre, she/he welcomes visitors, partners and clients in a warm and professional manner and provides clear, accurate information regarding the centre's services and activities.

Information Management
 She/he maintains all records, files and databases, ensures confidentiality and data security, oversees the publication and updates of House Rules on Chainels and manages internal communication such as "What's Up" on Chainels.

Support to Management
 She/he assists the Facility Manager with follow-up on files such as security and insurance, prepares ad hoc reports and summaries to support decision-making and provides occasional support to the marketing team when needed.

The ideal candidate demonstrates professionalism, discretion and strong organisational abilities.

Key criteria include:

• A flexible and hands-on approach.
• A degree in Business Administration, Secretarial Studies or a related field.
• Previous experience in an Executive Assistant, Office Manager or similar role; experience in a shopping-centre environment is a strong asset.
• Excellent organisational, prioritisation and time-management skills.
• Strong proficiency in MS Office and digital tools.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
• Ability to work autonomously, anticipate needs and take initiative.
• High level of discretion and a proactive mindset.
• Fluency in French, Dutch and English.

We are looking for a skilled Senior Accountant to join the Finance team in Leuven.

In this role, you will be a key pillar of our 6-member financial department, taking ownership of accounting tasks from A to Z.

To succeed, you must be experienced in Belgian and familiar with international accounting principles, highly analytical, and possess an high attention to detail. Your goal will be to drive the overall efficiency of our financial operations, ensure the accuracy and compliance of the day-to-day accounting and manage the month end closing process.

• Support the AP accountant with incoming invoices in accordance with Belgian accounting and VAT principles
• Manage the AP invoice approval cycle efficiently.
• Take ownership of the AP accounting for our subsidiaries (Germany, The Netherlands, UK, Finland, and Singapore). 
• Support bookings and meticulously reconcile bank statements.
• Register journal entries payroll bookings for Belgium and international entities.
• Manage fixed assets and book depreciations across all subsidiaries.
• Register prepaid expenses, accruals, and provisions.
• Prepare and file Belgian VAT returns, as well as VAT filings for foreign subsidiaries.
• Lead the monthly closing process for all corporate entities.
• Assist with group-level financial reconciliations, consolidation and reporting.
 

• Education: minimum Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (Finance, Accountancy) or equivalent experience.
• Experience: Minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience with Belgian accounting rules and VAT.
• Languages: Excellent command of English (spoken and written) alongside a good working knowledge of Dutch.
• Skills: Strong analytical acumen, great comfort with numbers, and an uncompromising attention to detail.
• Technical Proficiency: Deep understanding of Belgian accounting and financial reporting practices. Advanced knowledge of MS Office is required.
• Pluses: Previous experience with NetSuite and/or Salesforce is considered a strong asset.

Our client, an international organisation active in technical services and customer support, is undergoing a major digital transformation across its European operations. To support this journey, they are looking for an experienced Business Analyst & Transformation Project Lead .

In this key position within the organization , you will drive business improvement initiatives, manage strategic projects, and act as the link between operational teams and IT.

Key Responsibilities

Project & Programme Management

• Manage a portfolio of business transformation and IT-related projects.
• Define priorities, timelines, budgets, and project deliverables.
• Coordinate stakeholders and ensure projects are delivered on time and within scope.
• Identify and mitigate risks throughout the project lifecycle.
Business Process Improvement

• Analyse existing business processes and identify opportunities for optimisation.
• Drive initiatives focused on standardisation, automation, and digitalisation.
• Support the development of scalable and efficient operational practices.
Requirements Analysis

• Gather, analyse, and document business requirements.
• Translate operational and commercial needs into clear functional specifications.
• Ensure requirements are understood by technical teams and external partners.
• Solution Development
Collaborate closely with IT and business systems teams.

• Evaluate and implement solutions that support both current and future business needs.
• Ensure technology investments deliver measurable business value.
Commercial & Supplier Management

• Support and lead commercial initiatives related to projects and business improvements.
• Manage relationships with external suppliers and service providers.
• Participate in contract discussions and monitor project budgets and performance.
 

Stakeholder Management

• Act as the primary contact between business operations and IT teams
• Build strong relationships across departments and facilitate effective communication.
• Ensure business priorities are clearly understood and aligned.

• Has proven experience managing business transformation projects and programmes.
• Demonstrates strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Is comfortable working with data and translating insights into actionable recommendations.
• Possesses strong commercial awareness and can assess the business impact of decisions.
• Has experience gathering and documenting business requirements.
• Can communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Builds strong working relationships and influences stakeholders at different levels.
• Thrives in a dynamic environment and can manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
• Has experience working with IT, ERP, CRM, or other business systems teams.
• Is fluent in English; knowledge of Dutch and/or French  is considered an asset.

Our client, a biotech company based in Zwijnaarde, is bringing innovative CAR-T cell therapy to Ghent. With this treatment, they make a real difference every day in the lives of patients with cancer and other serious diseases.

The company is growing fast and is looking for motivated and dedicated team members.

Jobomschrijving

At Legend Biotech, as a Quality Control Support, you’ll have the chance to make a real difference.Your work will directly contribute to improving the lives of sick patients around the world.

Your responsibilities include:
	
• You assist with daily quality analyses and help ensure reliable test results.	
• You check, clean, and disinfect equipment, and manage lab materials and waste.	
• ou ensure safe and accurate sample transfers between departments.	
• You assist with various analyses in the labs.	
• You accurately log all your tasks in logs, forms, or the quality system.

	
• You have experience in Quality, preferably.	
• You live nearby Ghent and can easily commute to work, even without public transportation.	
• You speak English well.	
• You have a clean and accurate working style.	
• You collaborate well with others.	
• You are comfortable working with a laptop and MS-Office.	
• You are flexible and able to work in shifts.
